description: The bar chart compares the popularity of different categories across various models and accuracy levels. The horizontal axis contains three categories: Movies, Songs, and Basketball, while the vertical axis is labeled "Popularity" and ranges from 20 to 220 with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 40. Each category is represented by a group of bars, with three models (Llama3, Qwen2, and ChatGPT) and three accuracy levels (Acc=0 & GT Ans, Acc=0 & Gene Ans, and Acc=1 & GT Ans) visually distinguished by color and pattern. The Llama3 model is represented by blue bars, Qwen2 by red, and ChatGPT by yellow; within each model, Acc=0 & GT Ans is represented by a dotted pattern, Acc=0 & Gene Ans by a diagonal stripe pattern, and Acc=1 & GT Ans by a solid fill. For the Movies category, the bars are relatively short, with values around 30-40; for Songs, the values are higher, around 50-70; and for Basketball, the values are the highest, ranging from approximately 100 to over 200, with the Qwen2 model at Acc=0 & Gene Ans reaching around 210 and Llama3 at Acc=1 & GT Ans reaching around 180; the bars are not sorted in a specific order within each category group. Overall, the chart provides a visual representation of how popularity varies across different categories and models, with Basketball showing the highest popularity across all models and accuracy levels.
